subject.title: Subagent sessions persist after completion, main session becomes unresponsive

question: Should completed one-shot/run-mode subagent sessions remain visible retained history by default, be automatically hidden/archived/deleted after completion, or be split into retained history plus non-active UI/status projections?
rationale: Current code and tests deliberately preserve keep-mode run subagents, while the issue and docs expect completed subagents not to pollute active session/status surfaces; changing this default is a user-visible session-history and upgrade contract decision.

options.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
options.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking with explicit cleanup actions.

options.title: Auto-Archive Completed Runs
options.body: Archive or hide completed one-shot subagent sessions by default, accepting a retention behavior change that needs docs, migration/upgrade proof, and focused UI/session tests.

options.title: Add Explicit Retention Policy
options.body: Introduce a retention knob only if maintainers decide existing cleanup, archive, and doctor surfaces cannot safely express the desired behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve History, Fix Visibility
recommendation.body: Keep completed child transcripts by default, but make session/task/Control UI/WebChat projections immediately mark them terminal and non-blocking with explicit cleanup actions.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent session organization and multi-surface UI/Gateway history make steipete the strongest routing candidate for the retention and visibility contract choice.
